# `prepaid_lifecycle_setting`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

The prepaid lifecycle durations (one row). Transitions are derived from them on every worker tick, so a change applies to every transition not yet taken.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `boolean` | no | `true` | Always true: the table holds one row. |
| `grace_days` | `integer` | no | `3` | Days the service stays on after the plan expired unpaid (the grace period). |
| `suspension_days` | `integer` | no | `30` | Days the line stays suspended on the network before it is deactivated. |
| `number_aging_days` | `integer` | no | `90` | Days a deactivated line's number is held (TMF639 quarantined) before it can be assigned again. |
| `payg_zero_balance_days` | `integer` | no | `7` | Days a pay-as-you-go account may hold a zero balance before the grace period starts. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Last change by an operator (injected clock); null while the defaults stand. |

| `prepaid_lifecycle_setting_id_check` | check | `CHECK (id)` |
| `prepaid_lifecycle_setting_number_aging_days_check` | check | `CHECK (((number_aging_days >= 0) AND (number_aging_days <= 3650)))` |
| `prepaid_lifecycle_setting_payg_zero_balance_days_check` | check | `CHECK (((payg_zero_balance_days >= 0) AND (payg_zero_balance_days <= 365)))` |
| `prepaid_lifecycle_setting_suspension_days_check` | check | `CHECK (((suspension_days >= 0) AND (suspension_days <= 3650)))` |
| `prepaid_lifecycle_setting_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
